Alert schedules now offer Triggered only and All at once. The migration switches existing alert schedules to Triggered only for future events while preserving accepted jobs; cron schedules are unchanged.

Add multiline automation editors, visible rule/schedule UUIDs, reliable completion events, and retained stdout/stderr template fields. Helpers run before the 4 KiB per-substitution limit; webhook access now requires jobs:read. Reduce layout work when opening large alert policies.

Update the server, web UI and CLI together. Endpoint agents need no update for these changes.
